bg.tu_varna.sit.a1.f23621653.commands.enums.CommandName
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CommandName>, Constable
public enum CommandName extends Enum<CommandName>
Enum representing the supported command names in the XML parser. Each command corresponds to a specific operation within the application.
